name: Exception Handling Process
description: FirstUK Bank's operational procedure for managing exceptions across banking operations. This is the primary end-to-end workflow governing how exceptions are identified, escalated, and resolved within the organization. The process is owned by the Head of Operations and applies to Operations Staff, Customer Service, and Compliance teams.
context: Audience | Operations Staff, Customer Service, Compliance

name: Head of Operations
description: Senior leadership role responsible for owning and overseeing the Exception Handling Process. This role has accountability for the SOP's design, implementation, and ongoing management.

name: Operations Staff
description: Team members responsible for executing exception handling procedures as part of their operational duties. They are identified as a primary audience for this SOP.
context: Audience | Operations Staff, Customer Service, Compliance

name: Customer Service
description: Customer-facing team responsible for handling exceptions that impact customer interactions and service delivery. They are identified as a primary audience for this SOP.
context: Audience | Operations Staff, Customer Service, Compliance

name: Compliance
description: Compliance function responsible for ensuring exceptions are handled in accordance with regulatory and policy requirements. They are identified as a primary audience for this SOP.
context: Audience | Operations Staff, Customer Service, Compliance

name: Operational Exception Resolution Process
description: End-to-end procedure for identifying, investigating, and resolving operational exceptions including failed transactions, disputed transactions, and regulatory exceptions. Designed to ensure customer satisfaction and regulatory compliance throughout the resolution workflow.
context: Establish procedures for identifying, investigating, and resolving operational exceptions (failed transactions, disputed transactions, regulatory exceptions)
ensure customer satisfaction and regulatory compliance
purpose: Identify, investigate, and resolve operational exceptions (failed transactions, disputed transactions, regulatory exceptions) to ensure customer satisfaction and regulatory compliance
outcome_success: Customer satisfaction and regulatory compliance achieved

name: Exception Identification
description: Initial step to identify and flag operational exceptions including failed transactions, disputed transactions, and regulatory exceptions within the banking system.
context: identifying, investigating, and resolving operational exceptions (failed transactions, disputed transactions, regulatory exceptions)
purpose: Identify and flag operational exceptions in the system

name: Exception Investigation
description: Detailed examination and analysis of identified operational exceptions to determine root cause, impact, and appropriate resolution pathway.
context: identifying, investigating, and resolving operational exceptions
purpose: Investigate the root cause and details of the identified exception

name: Exception Resolution
description: Final step to implement corrective actions and resolve operational exceptions, ensuring customer satisfaction and regulatory compliance requirements are met.
context: identifying, investigating, and resolving operational exceptions to ensure customer satisfaction and regulatory compliance
purpose: Implement corrective actions and resolve the exception

name: Failed Transaction
description: A financial transaction that did not complete successfully and requires investigation and resolution as part of the operational exception process.
context: failed transactions, disputed transactions, regulatory exceptions

name: Disputed Transaction
description: A financial transaction that a customer has contested or disputed, requiring investigation and resolution to ensure customer satisfaction and regulatory compliance.
context: failed transactions, disputed transactions, regulatory exceptions

name: Regulatory Exception Compliance Gate
description: Mandatory compliance checkpoint to verify that regulatory exceptions are properly identified, investigated, and resolved in accordance with regulatory requirements.
context: ensure customer satisfaction and regulatory compliance
purpose: Ensure regulatory compliance for operational exceptions

name: Exception Handling Process
description: End-to-end operational procedure for managing failed transactions, disputed transactions, regulatory exceptions, and escalation to resolution. Covers deposits, withdrawals, transfers, customer claims of unauthorized activity, and compliance failures requiring audit investigation.

name: Failed Transaction
description: A transaction event (deposit, withdrawal, or transfer) that has failed to complete successfully and requires investigation and resolution under the exception handling process.

name: Disputed Transaction
description: A transaction where the customer claims the activity was unauthorized and requires investigation and potential reversal or reimbursement under the exception handling process.

name: Customer
description: A natural person who holds an account and may initiate exception claims, including disputes over unauthorized transactions or complaints regarding failed transactions.

name: Regulatory Exception Compliance Checkpoint
description: Mandatory control point verifying compliance with regulatory obligations when exceptions occur, including identification and escalation of compliance failures and audit issues requiring formal investigation and reporting.

name: Transaction Failure Resolution Process
description: End-to-end procedure for identifying, investigating, and resolving failed transactions across multiple channels including bank transfers, ATM withdrawals, standing orders, and direct debits. The process prioritizes high-impact customer issues with a defined SLA of 1–3 business days for resolution.
context: Transaction initiated but not completed successfully
purpose: Resolve transaction failures and restore customer confidence
scope: Bank transfers, ATM withdrawals, standing orders, direct debits
outcome_success: Transaction completed or customer notified with resolution
outcome_failure: Unresolved transaction; customer escalation or complaint

name: Transaction Failure Detection
description: Initial identification and categorization of failed transactions across channels including bank transfers, ATM withdrawals, standing orders, and direct debits.
context: Transaction initiated but not completed successfully
purpose: Identify and categorize transaction failures

name: Transaction Failure Investigation
description: Detailed examination of the root cause of transaction failure, including validation of recipient account details, fund availability, and account status.
purpose: Determine root cause of transaction failure
input: Transaction details, account status, failure logs
output: Root cause analysis and investigation report

name: Transaction Failure Resolution
description: Action taken to resolve the failed transaction, which may include correcting recipient details, retrying the transaction, or providing customer notification of the failure reason.
purpose: Execute corrective action and communicate outcome to customer
output: Resolution action taken, customer notification sent

name: Failed Bank Transfer
description: Bank transfer transaction that fails due to invalid recipient account details or other transfer-specific issues.

name: Denied ATM Withdrawal
description: ATM withdrawal transaction that is denied, typically due to insufficient funds in the customer's account.

name: Failed Standing Order
description: Standing order payment instruction that fails to execute, commonly due to the account being closed or other account status issues.

name: Rejected Direct Debit
description: Direct debit mandate that is rejected at the point of collection, typically due to insufficient funds in the customer's account.

name: Customer
description: Individual customer affected by transaction failure, who expects the initiated transaction to complete successfully and requires timely resolution.
context: Customer Impact: High (customer expecting transaction to complete)

name: Disputed Transaction
description: A financial transaction on a customer account that the customer claims was unauthorized, incorrectly charged, or recorded with wrong details such as amount or date. Disputed transactions require investigation within a defined SLA and carry high customer impact due to financial loss claims.
context: Customer claims transaction unauthorized or incorrect

name: Disputed Transaction Investigation Process
description: The operational procedure for investigating customer claims of unauthorized, incorrect, or wrongly recorded transactions. The process requires investigation completion within 5–10 business days and addresses high-impact financial loss claims.
context: Customer claims transaction unauthorized or incorrect
purpose: Investigate customer claims of unauthorized or incorrect transactions
scope: All disputed transactions reported by customers
outcome_success: Investigation completed with determination of liability and resolution
outcome_failure: Investigation not completed within SLA or customer dissatisfaction

name: Customer
description: A natural person who holds a banking account and initiates a dispute claim regarding an unauthorized, incorrect, or wrongly recorded transaction on that account.
context: Customer claims transaction unauthorized or incorrect
eligibility_or_verification_status: Has authority to raise dispute claim

name: Regulatory Exception Remediation Process
description: An operational or compliance issue flagged by audit/risk that requires remediation within a defined SLA. Examples include missing KYC documentation, AML screening delays, transactions outside policy limits, and regulatory reporting errors. Customer impact is typically low as these are internal issues that may require account restriction.
context: Operational or compliance issue flagged by audit/risk
purpose: Address operational or compliance issues flagged by audit/risk
customer_impact: Low (internal issue, may require account restriction)
trigger: Operational or compliance issue flagged by audit/risk

name: KYC Documentation Completeness Check
description: A regulatory checkpoint verifying that required KYC documentation is present and complete. Flagged as a Category 3 exception when documentation is missing, requiring remediation within the defined SLA.

name: AML Screening Timeliness Check
description: A regulatory checkpoint ensuring AML screening is completed within required timeframes. Flagged as a Category 3 exception when screening is delayed, requiring remediation within the defined SLA.

name: Transaction Policy Limit Compliance Check
description: A regulatory checkpoint verifying that transactions comply with established policy limits. Flagged as a Category 3 exception when a transaction falls outside policy limits, requiring remediation within the defined SLA.

name: Regulatory Reporting Accuracy Check
description: A regulatory checkpoint ensuring accuracy of regulatory reporting submissions. Flagged as a Category 3 exception when reporting errors are identified, requiring remediation within the defined SLA.

name: Know Your Customer Verification
description: The KYC verification process referenced in regulatory exceptions. Missing KYC documentation is identified as a Category 3 exception requiring remediation within 5–30 days depending on severity.

name: AML Screening
description: The AML screening process referenced in regulatory exceptions. Delays in AML screening are identified as Category 3 exceptions requiring remediation within 5–30 days depending on severity.

name: Audit and Risk Team
description: The organizational function responsible for flagging operational or compliance issues as Category 3 regulatory exceptions. This team identifies issues such as missing KYC documentation, AML screening delays, transactions outside policy limits, and regulatory reporting errors.
context: Operational or compliance issue flagged by audit/risk
authority_level: Flags operational and compliance issues for remediation

name: Exception Detection Process
description: An automated operational procedure that continuously monitors customer accounts and transactions for defined exception conditions including failed transactions, unusual patterns, regulatory alerts, and KYC/AML verification issues. Detected exceptions are automatically logged to an exception queue for downstream handling.
context: System Monitors For: Failed transaction attempts (system logs), Unusual transaction patterns (fraud rules), Regulatory alerts (compliance flagged), KYC/AML exceptions (verification issues)
purpose: Identify and log failed transactions, unusual patterns, regulatory alerts, and KYC/AML exceptions
scope: All transactions and customer verification events
trigger: Automated system monitoring of transaction attempts and customer verification status
outcome_success: Exceptions automatically logged to exception queue for review
outcome_failure: Exceptions not captured or logged, creating compliance and fraud detection gaps

name: Failed Transaction Monitoring
description: A monitoring step that detects and captures failed transaction attempts from system logs as part of the exception detection workflow.
output: Failed transaction records flagged for exception queue
failure_path: Failed transactions not detected; customer may retry or escalate without investigation

name: Unusual Transaction Pattern Detection
description: A monitoring step that identifies unusual transaction patterns using configured fraud rules to detect potentially anomalous account activity.
failure_path: Fraudulent or suspicious transactions pass undetected

name: Regulatory Alert Monitoring
description: A monitoring step that captures regulatory alerts that have been flagged by the compliance function as part of the exception detection workflow.
output: Regulatory alerts logged to exception queue
failure_path: Regulatory violations not escalated; compliance breach risk

name: KYC/AML Exception Detection
description: A monitoring step that identifies exceptions arising from KYC and AML verification issues, including incomplete or failed verification checks.
input: KYC verification status and AML screening results
failure_path: Verification failures not detected; non-compliant accounts remain active

name: Exception Queue Logging
description: An automated step that logs all detected exceptions to a centralized exception queue for subsequent processing and investigation.
failure_path: Exceptions not logged; no audit trail or escalation path available

name: Exception Detection System
description: An automated system responsible for continuously monitoring transactions and account activity against defined exception criteria, logging detected exceptions to the exception queue.
authority_level: Automated detection and logging; no approval authority

name: Failed Transaction
description: A transaction that has failed to complete successfully, captured from system logs as part of the exception detection monitoring process.

name: Unusual Transaction Pattern
description: A transaction or series of transactions that deviate from normal customer behavior patterns and are flagged by configured fraud detection rules.
monitoring_or_reporting_obligation: Flagged by fraud rules and logged to exception queue

name: KYC/AML Exception Screening
description: An ongoing screening process that monitors for exceptions and issues arising from KYC and AML verification checks, flagging incomplete or failed verifications.
screening_lists_or_scope: KYC verification issues and AML exceptions
hit_or_match_response: Exception flagged and logged to exception queue

name: KYC Verification Exception
description: An exception condition detected when KYC verification checks fail or reveal issues requiring investigation or remediation.
verification_method: Automated system check against KYC verification status
consequence_of_failure: Exception logged for manual review and remediation

name: Fraud Detection Alert
description: An automated alert generated when the system detects unusual transaction patterns or other indicators of potential fraud through configured fraud detection rules.
generation_trigger: Unusual transaction patterns detected by fraud rules
investigation_or_escalation_path: Logged to exception queue for review and investigation

name: Manual Fraud Detection Process
description: A process by which fraud cases are identified and reported through multiple channels including customer complaints, teller observations, audit findings, and regulatory communications. Cases are logged by staff and escalated to the exception team for investigation.
context: Logged by staff, escalated to exception team
purpose: Detect and escalate fraud cases through staff observation, customer complaints, audit findings, and regulatory communication
scope: All channels (branch, phone, email); all transaction types
outcome_success: Fraud case identified, logged, and escalated to exception team for investigation
outcome_failure: Fraud case missed or not escalated in timely manner

name: Customer Complaint Reporting
description: A step in which customers report suspected fraud or suspicious activity through multiple channels: phone, email, or in-person at a branch.
input: Customer complaint received via phone, email, or in-branch

name: Teller Transaction Observation
description: A step in which teller staff observe and report transactions that are rejected or appear suspicious during normal processing.
output: Transaction rejected or flagged; observation logged

name: Audit Control Testing
description: A step in which audit findings from control testing identify potential fraud or compliance exceptions.
input: Transaction records and control test results

name: Regulatory Exception Communication
description: A step in which regulatory communications alert the bank to potential fraud or exceptions requiring investigation.
output: Exception received and logged by bank

name: Case Logging and Escalation
description: A step in which staff log detected fraud cases and escalate them to the exception team for formal investigation and handling.
context: Logged by staff, escalated to exception team
input: Complaint, observation, audit finding, or regulatory exception
output: Case logged and escalated to exception team
failure_path: Case not escalated; fraud case remains unaddressed

name: Branch Staff
description: Branch staff members who report customer complaints, observe suspicious transactions, and log fraud cases for escalation.
context: Logged by staff, escalated to exception team

name: Exception Team
description: A specialized team responsible for receiving escalated fraud cases from branch staff and conducting investigation and resolution.
responsibility: coordinate with audit and regulatory functions

name: Audit Function
description: Internal audit function that performs control testing and identifies fraud findings that are reported as part of the manual detection process.

name: Regulator
description: External regulatory authority that communicates regulatory exceptions and fraud-related concerns to the bank.

name: Fraud Detection Obligation
description: The operational obligation to detect and report fraud through multiple channels including customer complaints, staff observations, audit findings, and regulatory communications.
investigation_or_escalation_path: Case logged by branch staff and escalated to exception team
monitoring_or_reporting_obligation: All fraud indicators must be logged and escalated

name: Exception Handling Process
description: End-to-end procedure for receiving, logging, categorizing, and assessing exceptions reported to the bank. The process begins with immediate logging upon exception receipt, followed by categorization into failed transactions, customer disputes, or regulatory matters, and concludes with severity assessment to determine escalation requirements.
purpose: Receive, categorize, and assess banking exceptions for appropriate routing and resolution
scope: All exception types: failed transactions, customer disputes, regulatory issues
trigger: Exception reported by staff or system
outcome_success: Exception logged, categorized, severity assessed, and escalation decision made

name: Exception Logging
description: Initial recording of an exception upon receipt. The step captures the exception ID, date/time, reporter name, and initial description in the system.
input: Exception report from staff or system
output: Exception ID (format: EXC-XXXXXXXX), logged date/time, reporter name, initial description

name: Exception Categorization
description: Classification of the reported exception into one of three categories: failed transaction, customer dispute, or regulatory matter. This step determines the handling pathway for the exception.
context: Is it a failed transaction? → Category 1
Is it a customer dispute? → Category 2

name: Exception Severity Assessment
description: Evaluation of the exception's severity based on multiple factors including monetary amount involved, customer impact, regulatory implications, and determination of whether escalation is required.
input: Categorized exception with financial and customer impact details

name: Exception Category Decision
description: Branching decision that routes the exception to one of three handling paths based on its nature: failed transaction (Category 1), customer dispute (Category 2), or regulatory matter (Category 3).
context: Is it a failed transaction? → Category 1
Is it a customer dispute? → Category 2
decision_question: What is the category of the exception?
path_yes: Assign category and proceed to severity assessment

name: Escalation Trigger Decision
description: Decision point that determines whether the exception requires escalation based on severity assessment factors including amount, customer impact, and regulatory implications.
decision_question: Is escalation required based on severity assessment?
path_yes: Escalate to appropriate authority

name: Exception Reporter
description: The person or system that identifies and reports an exception to the bank. Their name is recorded as part of the initial logging step.
authority_level: Can log, categorize, and assess exceptions; escalate based on severity

name: Failed Transaction Investigation Process
description: An operational procedure for investigating and resolving failed transactions on customer accounts. The process involves pulling transaction records, determining failure reasons, verifying customer authorization and account details, assessing reversibility, and determining appropriate resolution actions including refunds, retries, or customer explanation.
context: Outcome: Refund if funds were debited + failed, retry if appropriate, or explain to customer
purpose: Investigate and resolve failed transactions through systematic analysis of failure reasons and appropriate remediation
scope: Failed transactions across all account types
outcome_success: Transaction resolved through refund, retry, or customer explanation
outcome_failure: Unresolved transaction dispute or customer dissatisfaction

name: Transaction Record Retrieval
description: The initial step of pulling the transaction record from the system to begin investigation of a failed transaction.

name: Transaction Status Check
description: Examination of the transaction status to determine the reason for failure.
failure_path: Escalate to decision point for failure reason determination

name: Customer Authorization Verification
description: Verification that the customer authorized the failed transaction.

name: Account Details Confirmation
description: Confirmation that the account details provided in the transaction are correct.

name: Reversibility Assessment
description: Assessment of whether the failed transaction can be reversed or refunded.

name: Balance Confirmation at Transaction Attempt
description: Confirmation of the customer's account balance at the time of the failed transaction attempt to verify insufficient funds as the failure reason.
context: Confirm balance at time of attempt
output: Balance at time of transaction attempt

name: Recipient Account Number Validation
description: Verification of the recipient account number format to identify if invalid recipient details caused the transaction failure.

name: Account Freeze Status Confirmation
description: Confirmation of whether an account freeze is in place and the reason for the freeze when account frozen is identified as the failure reason.
context: Confirm freeze in place and reason

name: Duplicate Transaction Check
description: Verification of whether an earlier identical transaction exists to determine if duplicate prevention rules caused the transaction failure.

name: Customer Notification and Resolution
description: Communication to the customer explaining the failure reason and offering appropriate resolution such as retry, refund, or explanation of policy.
context: Explain to customer, offer retry once funds available
Contact customer for correct details, retry
Explain duplicate rule, offer manual retry
output: Customer notification, refund or retry authorization

name: Transaction Failure Reason Determination
description: A branching decision point that categorizes the transaction failure into one of five common reasons: insufficient funds, invalid recipient, account frozen, duplicate prevention, or other. Each reason path leads to specific investigation and resolution steps.
decision_question: What is the root cause of the transaction failure?
path_yes: Route to appropriate failure-specific investigation path

name: Insufficient Funds Failure Path
description: Decision path triggered when insufficient funds is identified as the transaction failure reason, leading to balance confirmation and customer explanation with retry offer.
context: Insufficient funds | Confirm balance at time of attempt | Explain to customer, offer retry once funds available
decision_question: Were funds insufficient at time of transaction attempt?
criteria: Balance at transaction timestamp less than transaction amount
path_yes: Explain to customer, offer retry once funds available

name: Invalid Recipient Failure Path
description: Decision path triggered when invalid recipient details are identified as the transaction failure reason, leading to account number format verification and customer contact for correction.
context: Invalid recipient | Check account number format | Contact customer for correct details, retry
decision_question: Is the recipient account number invalid or incorrectly formatted?
path_yes: Contact customer for correct details, retry transaction

name: Account Frozen Failure Path
description: Decision path triggered when an account freeze is identified as the transaction failure reason, leading to freeze confirmation and conditional unfreezing with customer notification.
context: Account frozen | Confirm freeze in place and reason | Unfreeze if valid, notify customer
decision_question: Is the account frozen?
criteria: Account freeze status confirmed in system
path_yes: Unfreeze if valid, notify customer

name: Duplicate Prevention Failure Path
description: Decision path triggered when duplicate prevention rules are identified as the transaction failure reason, leading to earlier transaction verification and customer explanation with manual retry offer.
context: Duplicate prevention | Check for earlier same transaction | Explain duplicate rule, offer manual retry
decision_question: Is this a duplicate of an earlier transaction?
criteria: Matching transaction found in recent history with same amount, recipient, and timestamp proximity
path_yes: Explain duplicate prevention rule to customer, offer manual retry

name: Transaction Investigation Investigator
description: The operations staff member responsible for executing the failed transaction investigation steps, including pulling records, verifying details, assessing reversibility, and determining appropriate resolution.
authority_level: Investigation and resolution authority for failed transactions

name: Account Freeze Authority
description: The role responsible for unfreezing an account when the freeze is determined to be valid and the transaction failure is resolved.
authority_level: Account freeze and unfreeze decision authority

name: Failed Transaction
description: A financial transaction that did not complete successfully on a customer account, requiring investigation to determine the failure reason and appropriate resolution including potential refund or retry.
context: Outcome: Refund if funds were debited + failed, retry if appropriate, or explain to customer

name: Customer Account
description: A customer account subject to transaction processing and potential failure scenarios requiring investigation and resolution.
context: Account frozen | Confirm freeze in place and reason

name: Customer
description: The account holder whose transaction has failed and who requires notification and resolution of the failure.
context: Explain to customer, offer retry once funds available
Contact customer for correct details, retry
context_role: Transaction initiator and recipient of investigation outcome

name: Disputed Transaction Investigation Process
description: An end-to-end investigation procedure for handling disputed transactions on customer accounts. The process involves pulling transaction details, verifying customer authorization, checking timestamps and amounts, reviewing customer history for patterns, and assessing fraud likelihood. Investigation outcomes determine whether a full refund is issued within 10 days, the transaction is confirmed as authorized with customer education, or further investigation and escalation is required.
context: Pull transaction details, Verify customer authorized, Check timestamp and amount, Review customer history (patterns?), Assess fraud likelihood
purpose: Investigate disputed transactions to determine authorization status and appropriate remediation
scope: All disputed transactions reported by customers
trigger: Customer reports a transaction as unauthorized or disputed
outcome_success: Transaction status determined (authorized, unauthorized, or requires further investigation) with appropriate customer action taken
outcome_failure: Investigation inconclusive or customer dissatisfied with resolution

name: Pull Transaction Details
description: The first step in the disputed transaction investigation where transaction details are retrieved and made available for review.
output: Complete transaction record including amount, timestamp, recipient, and payment method

name: Verify Customer Authorization
description: A verification step to confirm whether the customer authorized the disputed transaction.

name: Check Timestamp and Amount
description: A review step that examines the timestamp and monetary amount of the disputed transaction to establish transaction details and timeline.
context: Timeline: When reported vs. when occurred?
input: Transaction timestamp, transaction amount, customer report date

name: Review Customer History
description: An analysis step that examines the customer's transaction history and patterns to identify anomalies or indicators of fraud.
output: Pattern analysis identifying anomalies or consistency with customer behavior

name: Assess Fraud Likelihood
description: A decision-support step that evaluates the overall likelihood of fraud based on collected evidence and analysis.
input: Authorization status, timeline analysis, pattern review, recipient verification
output: Fraud likelihood assessment and recommendation for outcome path

name: Transaction Authorization Status Decision
description: A branching decision point that determines the outcome of the disputed transaction investigation based on whether the transaction was authorized, unauthorized, or remains disputed. Each path leads to a different resolution outcome.
context: Outcomes: Unauthorized: Full refund within 10 days, Authorized: Explain, educate customer, Disputed: Further investigation or escalation
decision_question: Was the transaction authorized by the customer?
path_yes: Proceed to Authorized Transaction Customer Education

name: Unauthorized Transaction Refund
description: The outcome path when a disputed transaction is determined to be unauthorized, resulting in a full refund to the customer within 10 days.
customer_notification: Notify customer of refund approval and timeline

name: Authorized Transaction Customer Education
description: The outcome path when a disputed transaction is confirmed as authorized by the customer, requiring explanation and customer education.
investigation_or_escalation_path: Contact customer to explain transaction and provide security education
customer_notification: Explain transaction details and circumstances to customer

name: Disputed Transaction Further Investigation
description: The outcome path when a disputed transaction cannot be conclusively determined as authorized or unauthorized, requiring further investigation or escalation.
generation_trigger: Transaction status remains disputed or inconclusive after initial assessment
investigation_or_escalation_path: Escalate for further investigation or specialist review
customer_notification: Inform customer that investigation is ongoing

name: Disputed Transaction
description: A financial transaction on a customer account that is contested by the customer and subject to investigation to determine authorization status and fraud likelihood.
context: To whom was money sent? (known party?)
monitoring_or_reporting_obligation: Investigation required to determine authorization status

name: Customer
description: The account holder who disputes a transaction and is the subject of the investigation process. The customer's authorization status, negligence, and transaction history are key factors in determining the investigation outcome.
context_role: Initiator of dispute; subject of authorization verification and fraud assessment

name: Regulatory Exception Investigation Process
description: An end-to-end procedure for identifying, assessing, and remediating regulatory compliance exceptions including missing KYC, delayed AML screening, and rate errors. The process includes impact assessment, remediation determination, cross-customer impact analysis, and audit documentation.
context: Investigation Steps: 1. Identify specific regulatory issue 2. Assess impact (customer-facing vs. internal) 3. Determine remediation steps 4. Check if other customers affected 5. Document for audit trail
purpose: Investigate and remediate regulatory exceptions including missing KYC, AML delays, and rate errors
scope: All customer accounts and regulatory compliance failures
trigger: Detection of regulatory exception (missing KYC, AML delay, rate error, etc.)
outcome_success: Exception identified, impact assessed, remediation completed, audit trail documented, affected customers identified
outcome_failure: Regulatory breach remains unresolved, audit trail incomplete, systemic issues undetected

name: Identify Specific Regulatory Issue
description: The initial step in the regulatory exception investigation where the specific compliance violation or regulatory breach is identified and documented.

name: Assess Impact
description: Evaluation of the regulatory exception to determine whether the impact is customer-facing or internal, informing the severity and remediation approach.

name: Determine Remediation Steps
description: The step where specific corrective actions are identified and planned to resolve the identified regulatory exception.

name: Check if Other Customers Affected
description: A cross-customer impact analysis to determine whether the regulatory exception affects other customer accounts or is isolated to a single account.
input: Identified regulatory issue and remediation plan

name: Document for Audit Trail
description: The final step where all findings, actions taken, and remediation outcomes are formally documented for audit and compliance purposes.
input: Complete investigation findings, remediation actions, affected customer list

name: Identity Verification
description: The Know Your Customer verification process requiring collection and validation of customer identification documents at account opening. The regulatory exception example indicates accounts opened without this verification must be remediated immediately.
context: Missing KYC | Account opened without ID verification | Obtain missing docs immediately, suspend if can't provide
consequence_of_failure: Account suspended until missing documents obtained

name: Customer Screening
description: Anti-Money Laundering screening process that must be completed at or immediately after account opening. The regulatory exception example identifies delays in screening completion as a compliance violation requiring retroactive screening and escalation if flagged.
context: AML delay | Customer screened 3 days after opening | Retroactive screening, escalate if flagged
hit_or_match_response: Escalate if flagged; retroactive screening if delayed

name: Identification Document
description: Official identity documentation required during account opening as part of KYC verification. The regulatory exception process requires immediate collection of missing identification documents or account suspension.
context: Missing KYC | Account opened without ID verification | Obtain missing docs immediately, suspend if can't provide
collection_steps: Obtain from customer at account opening
recording_obligation: Record in customer file and compliance system

name: Customer Account
description: A customer account subject to regulatory exception investigation, including accounts opened without proper KYC verification, with delayed AML screening, or with rate calculation errors.
closure_or_freeze_conditions: Account suspended if KYC documentation cannot be provided

name: Customer
description: The individual customer subject to regulatory exception investigation and remediation, including those affected by missing KYC, delayed AML screening, or rate errors.
context: Obtain missing docs immediately, suspend if can't provide
eligibility_or_verification_status: Subject to KYC and AML verification requirements

name: KYC Verification Checkpoint
description: A mandatory regulatory compliance gate requiring identity verification and document collection before account opening is completed. Failure to pass this checkpoint is identified as a regulatory exception requiring immediate remediation.
context: Missing KYC | Account opened without ID verification | Obtain missing docs immediately, suspend if can't provide

name: AML Screening Checkpoint
description: A mandatory regulatory compliance gate requiring Anti-Money Laundering screening to be completed at or immediately after account opening. Delays in completing this checkpoint are identified as regulatory exceptions requiring retroactive screening and escalation.
context: AML delay | Customer screened 3 days after opening | Retroactive screening, escalate if flagged
timing: At or immediately after account opening
failure_consequence: Escalation if customer flagged; retroactive screening if delayed

name: Failed Transaction Resolution Process
description: End-to-end procedure for resolving failed transactions on customer accounts. Defines three resolution pathways: reprocessing with fund confirmation, refund with compensation, or manual facilitation with documented override approval. Scope covers transaction failures where funds were debited or processing was blocked by system controls.
purpose: Resolve failed transactions through reprocessing, refund, or manual facilitation
outcome_success: Transaction successfully reprocessed, refunded, or manually facilitated with customer notified
outcome_failure: Transaction remains unresolved; customer dissatisfaction; potential compensation liability

name: Fund Availability Confirmation
description: Verification step to confirm that customer funds are now available before reprocessing a failed transaction. Precedes resubmission under Option A.
input: Failed transaction record; customer account balance
purpose: Verify funds are now available before resubmission attempt

name: Transaction Resubmission
description: Operational step to resubmit a previously failed transaction to the payment system after fund availability has been confirmed. Part of Option A resolution pathway.
input: Failed transaction details; confirmed fund availability
purpose: Reprocess the transaction through payment system

name: Transaction Success Confirmation to Customer
description: Customer-facing notification step confirming successful reprocessing of a previously failed transaction. Completes Option A pathway.
purpose: Inform customer of successful transaction completion

name: Exception Closure
description: Administrative step to formally close the exception record after successful transaction resolution. Marks the end of the resolution workflow.
purpose: Close the failed transaction exception record

name: Refund Processing
description: Immediate refund of funds to customer account when funds were debited despite transaction failure. First step in Option B compensation pathway.
context: If funds were debited despite failure: Refund immediately
input: Confirmation that funds were debited despite transaction failure
purpose: Return debited funds to customer when transaction failed but funds were taken

name: Interest Addition
description: Conditional step to add interest to refunded amount where applicable, compensating customer for loss of use of funds during failed transaction period.
input: Refund amount; applicable interest rate; duration of debit
purpose: Compensate customer for loss of funds during failed transaction period

name: Service Failure Apology
description: Customer communication step acknowledging service failure and expressing apology. Part of Option B resolution pathway.
purpose: Acknowledge service failure to customer

name: Compensation Assessment
description: Discretionary assessment step to determine whether additional compensation beyond refund and interest is warranted based on service failure severity.
input: Service failure evidence; customer impact assessment
purpose: Evaluate and determine if compensation is warranted for service failure

name: Manual Transaction Facilitation
description: Staff-executed step to manually process a transaction when customer wishes to proceed but system controls block the transaction. Requires documented approvals and override justification.
input: Customer request; system block reason; approval authorization
purpose: Manually process transaction when customer wants to proceed but system blocks

description: End-to-end procedure for resolving customer disputes over transactions, with three distinct resolution paths: refund for unauthorized or merchant error cases, customer education for authorized but regretted transactions, or escalation to merchant via card scheme chargeback claim. The process defines decision criteria, timelines, and customer communication requirements for each path.

name: Refund Processing

name: Regulatory Exceptions Resolution Process
description: An end-to-end procedure for resolving regulatory exceptions that arise during account operations. The process provides three distinct resolution paths: immediate remediation, escalation for management approval, or temporary account restriction pending resolution. Each path includes documentation and customer notification requirements as applicable.
context: Fix the issue (get missing KYC, correct rate, etc.)
If regulatory issue cannot be immediately resolved
purpose: Resolve regulatory exceptions through immediate remediation, management escalation, or temporary account restriction

outcome_success: Exception resolved and documented; account restored to normal operation or approved restricted state
outcome_failure: Exception remains unresolved; account remains restricted or escalation blocked

name: Immediate Remediation
description: The first resolution option where the regulatory exception is fixed directly by addressing the underlying issue such as obtaining missing KYC documentation or correcting an erroneous rate. This step includes customer notification if required and formal documentation of the remediation action before closing the exception.
context: Fix the issue (get missing KYC, correct rate, etc.)
purpose: Resolve regulatory exception directly without escalation
failure_path: Escalate to management approval (Option B) or implement temporary account restriction (Option C)

name: Escalation for Management Approval

purpose: Obtain management decision on regulatory exception resolution
failure_path: Implement temporary account restriction pending further review

name: Temporary Account Restriction

purpose: Restrict account transactions while regulatory issue is being resolved
failure_path: Escalate to Compliance Head for extended restriction or account closure review

name: Compliance Head
